name: WizCommerce for Business Central
brief: WZC unified entity APIs for WizCommerce Business Central V2
description: One shared API surface (publisher wizcommerce, group connector) for every WizCommerce tenant: v2.0 unified BUYER (wizCustomers + addresses + contacts), PRODUCT (wizItems + prices + variants + UoM), INVENTORY (wizInventoryFeedItems with server-side availability + future supply, wizInventoryByLocations) and ORDER (wizSalesOrders read, wizSalesOrderWrites idempotent push, wizSalesOrderArchives) APIs, plus the original v1.0 ship-to address, customer price, shipment tracking and item availability APIs. Tenant behaviour is configuration (Field Visibility, Sync Profiles, Attributes), not code. Sync logic stays in WizCommerce.
